videos.caption: Blanket Dumplings 🥟 These dumplings definitely live up to the hype. They’re by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Because this is a labor of love. 🤎🔥 For Black History Month, I’m bringing back Burnt Sugar Cake, a historic Black Southern celebration cake that slowly faded when box mixes took over. Burnt Sugar Cake Burnt Sugar Syrup • 1 cup granulated sugar (200 g) • 1 cup boiling water (240 ml) Melt sugar over medium heat until deep amber (do not stir, swirl pan). Carefully add boiling water, stir smooth, simmer 3–5 min. Cool. Reserve ½ cup for cake + ½ cup for frosting. Cake • 1 cup butter, softened (227 g) • 2 cups sugar (400 g) • 4 eggs • 3 cups cake flour (360 g) • 1 tbsp baking powder (14 g) • ½ tsp salt • 1 cup whole milk (240 ml) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • 2 tsp vanilla Heat oven to 350°F / 175°C. Grease three 8-inch pans. Cream butter + sugar 3–5 min. Add eggs one at a time. Whisk dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients + milk into batter. Mix in burnt sugar syrup + vanilla. Bake 25–30 min. Cool completely. Traditional Burnt Sugar Frosting (work fast!) • ½ cup butter (113 g) • 1 cup brown sugar (200 g) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • ¼ cup evaporated milk (60 ml) • 3–4 cups powdered sugar (360–480 g) • pinch salt + 1 tsp vanilla Boil butter, brown sugar, syrup & milk 2 minutes. Cool until warm, then beat in powdered sugar, salt & vanilla. Frost cake quickly before it sets. Optional Brown Sugar Penuche Frosting (creamier outside) • 1½ cups butter, divided (340 g) • 1½ cups brown sugar (300 g) • ½ cup heavy cream (120 ml) • 1 tsp salt • 4½ cups powdered sugar (540 g) Melt ¾ cup butter. Boil brown sugar + cream + salt. Beat into melted butter with powdered sugar. Add remaining butter 1 tbsp at a time. Rest 10–30 min until spreadable. Assemble Fill and frost cake with traditional burnt sugar frosting. Optional: cover outside with penuche frosting. Finish with rustic swoops and swirls. #BlackHistory #TikTokLearn#BlackHistoryBlackFoodHistory#TikTokLearningCampaigngeRecipes

Slow Cooker Pineapple BBQ Beef Roast Ingredients 1. Beef Chuck Roast – 3–4 lb (1.4–1.8 kg) 2. Pineapple Rings – 1 can (20 oz/565 g), drained, reserving 1/2 cup juice 3. Barbecue Sauce – 1 1/2 cups 4. Pineapple Juice – 1/2 cup, reserved from the can 5. Beef Broth – 1/2 cup 6. Yellow Onion – 1 large, sliced 7. Garlic – 5 cloves, minced 8. Worcestershire Sauce – 2 tbsp 9. Soy Sauce – 2 tbsp 10. Brown Sugar – 2 tbsp 11. Dijon Mustard – 1 tbsp 12. Smoked Paprika – 1 tsp 13. Ground Black Pepper – 1 tsp 14. Salt – 1 tsp, or to taste 15. Onion Powder – 1 tsp 16. Garlic Powder – 1 tsp 17. Olive Oil – 1 tbsp 18. Apple Cider Vinegar – 1 tbsp 19. Cornstarch – 1 tbsp, optional for thickening 20. Cold Water – 2 tbsp, optional for thickening 21. Fresh Parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped, for garnish Recipe 1. Pat the beef chuck roast dry with paper towels. Trim away any unusually thick pieces of excess fat while leaving enough marbling to keep the meat tender during slow cooking. 2. In a small bowl, combine the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Rub the seasoning mixture over all sides of the roast so the beef is evenly flavored. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the roast for 3–4 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. This step develops extra flavor, although you can skip it when short on time. 4. Place the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a 6–8-quart slow cooker. Set the seared beef roast on top of the onion mixture. 5. In a medium bowl, whisk together the barbecue sauce, reserved pineapple juice, beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, and apple cider vinegar until smooth. 6. Pour the prepared sauce over the beef, coating the top and sides generously. Arrange the pineapple rings around and on top of the roast so their sweet juices mingle with the savory barbecue sauce. 7. Cover the slow cooker with its lid and cook on LOW for 8–10 hours or on HIGH for approximately 4–6 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and pulls apart easily. Cooking time depends on the roast's size and the slow cooker. 8. Halfway through cooking, carefully spoon some of the sauce over the roast if convenient. Keep the lid closed as much as possible so the slow cooker maintains its temperature. 9. Once the beef is tender, transfer it carefully to a large platter. Use two forks to pull it into thick chunks or slices, depending on your preferred presentation. Remove any large pieces of fat. 10. Taste the cooking liquid and adjust the seasoning if necessary. For a richer glaze, transfer approximately 2 cups of the liquid to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 8–12 minutes until reduced and glossy. 11. For a thicker sauce, whisk the cornstarch and cold water together in a small bowl until smooth. Stir the slurry into the simmering sauce and cook for 1–2 minutes until thickened. Add only as much as needed to achieve your preferred consistency. 12. Return the beef to the slow cooker or place it in the saucepan with the reduced sauce. Gently toss the meat so every piece is coated in the sweet, tangy pineapple barbecue glaze. 13. Arrange the pineapple rings around the beef on a serving platter. Spoon additional sauce over the roast and garnish with freshly chopped parsley for a colorful finish. 14. Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

Easy homemade dinner rolls 😋🧈🍞 Ingredients: 1 cup warm milk (110 degrees F) 2 1/2 tsp active dry yeast 2 tbsp sugar  4 tbsp melted butter 1 egg 1 tsp salt 3 cups all purpose flour Instructions: Whisk together the warm milk, yeast, and sugar. Let sit for 10 minutes, until a layer of foam forms on top. Add the melted butter, egg, salt, and yeast mixture to the bowl of a stand mixer. Mix with the dough hook while gradually adding the flour. Knead with the dough hook for 5 minutes, then knead by hand for 2 to 3 minutes, until the dough is smooth. Transfer the dough to a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm spot for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Punch down the dough and divide it into 12 equal pieces. Flatten each piece slightly, pull the edges into the center, and shape it into a ball. Place the rolls seam-side down in a greased baking dish. Let rise for another 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, bake at 375 for 15 minutes, then brush the tops with melted butter while the rolls are still hot.
